get_GRanges_from_peak_gz_file <- function(peak_gz_file, treatment, sample_index, time) {
gz_file <- gzfile(peak_gz_file, "rt")
peak_data <- read.table(gz_file, header=F, sep = "\t")
colnames(peak_data) <- c("chr", "start", "end", "name", "score4Display", "strand", "signalValue", "-log10pValue", "-log10qValue", "peakSummit")
print(dim(peak_data))
print(tail(peak_data))
peak_data <- peak_data[which(peak_data$`-log10qValue` > 2), ] # selected only q-value < 0.01
print(dim(peak_data))
print(tail(peak_data))
legal_peak_data <- peak_data[which(peak_data$chr %in% legal_chromatin), ]
legal_peak_data$name <- paste0(treatment, "_", sample_index, "_", time, "_peak", row.names(legal_peak_data)) ##============== important!
GR <- GRanges(seqnames = Rle(legal_peak_data$chr),
IRanges(start = legal_peak_data$start, end = legal_peak_data$end),
names = legal_peak_data$name )
names(GR) = GR$names

get_peaks_GRanges_with_feature_name = function(sample_name, peakfile1, peakfile2, peakfile3, ...){ # around 10S for each call
dots <- list(...)
#dots <- list(peakfile1=IL2_1_.75, peakfile2=IL2_2_.75, peakfile3=IL2_3_.75)
if(length(dots) == 0) {
annot_peaks = rbind(peakfile1, peakfile2, peakfile3)
} else {
annot_peaks = rbind(peakfile1, peakfile2, peakfile3, dots[[1]])
}
colnames(annot_peaks)[1] <- "chr"
peak_info <- annot_peaks %>% dplyr::select (peakName, everything())
peaks_from_peak_file <- GRanges(seqnames = Rle(peak_info$chr),
IRanges(start = peak_info$start, end = peak_info$end),
names = peak_info$peakName )
merged_peaks <- GenomicRanges::reduce(peaks_from_peak_file) # merge overlapped peaks into region
feature_names = c(paste0(sample_name, "_reduced_peak", 1:length(merged_peaks)))
names(merged_peaks) = feature_names
merged_peaks
}
